goal:
Implement precise painting via zoom/pan on the pixel board, per the Oct 12 board review:

SCOPE (vertical slice, tie-breaker #2):
- One shared camera transform used by rendering, pointer hit-testing, and overlays.
- Overview zoom: whole board visible; tap selects a cell (current behavior preserved).
- Paint zoom: cells render at >=16 screen px; tap places paint directly on the selected cell (no form submit for this mode).
- Pan: drag pans the view; a drag MUST NEVER submit paint (explicit test).
- Zoom via wheel/pinch; keep 128x128 logical board unchanged.

JUDGMENT CONTEXT (docs/2026-10-14-product-judgment.md):
- The paint moment must feel great (tie-breaker #1): instant, precise.
- Mobile is first-class: touch pan/pinch vs tap distinction is required.
- Copy r/place patterns wholesale; do not invent novel interactions.
- Keep existing selection ring behavior at overview zoom.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Frontend only: web/src/**. No contract, wallet, or economy changes.
- Preserve all existing passing tests; add tests for: drag-does-not-paint, cell hit-testing under transform, zoom level thresholds.
- Verification: cd web && npm test (must pass), npm run build (must pass).

HANDOFF: emit the JSON record described by the orchestrator with real exit codes
from the commands you actually ran.
